title: Vorticity stretching in three dimensions
mathematical_role: Expose the geometric intuition of three-dimensional vortex stretching while keeping the global energy identity analytically separate.
learning_objective: See a vortex tube lengthen and thin along the vorticity/stretching direction, relate this to (ω·∇)u, and distinguish that mechanism from global energy dissipation.
literal_semantics: The vorticity equation displayed is ∂tω + (u·∇)ω = (ω·∇)u + νΔω.
Three ordered stages explicitly encode the qualitative sequence baseline tube → longer and thinner → amplified |ω|.
The global kinetic-energy identity is displayed in a separate analytic panel.
nonliteral_semantics: The vortex tubes are schematic perspective objects, not computed velocity or vorticity fields.
Tube length, thickness, and red magnitude bars are qualitative rather than numerical.
The arrows do not encode a computed strain eigenvector.
No energy cascade or finite-time singularity is simulated.

notes: The successor uses no simulation-derived output, so no initial-condition or discretization claim is introduced.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic SVG renderer v1
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.
Run the generator from any checkout; output paths and bytes are deterministic under the recorded Python-standard-library contract.

accessibility.alt_text: Three schematic three-dimensional vortex tubes lengthen and thin from t0 to t2 along a stretching direction while qualitative vorticity magnitude increases; the global energy identity is shown separately.
accessibility.long_description: Three perspective tube panels are labelled t0, t1, and t2. The tube becomes longer and thinner and a separate qualitative red magnitude bar grows. Arrows label the vorticity or stretch direction. Beneath the geometry, the vorticity stretching term is stated and the global kinetic-energy identity is placed in its own section. The boundary states that no numerical cascade, blow-up mechanism, or regularity result is depicted.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Pedagogical exposition of the coexistence of global energy control and the specifically three-dimensional vorticity-stretching mechanism.

supersession_reason: The successor explicitly renders a three-dimensional tube sequence and analytically separates vorticity stretching from the global energy identity.
